q: Which hospital level's checklist first requires an Intensive Care Unit and a NICU?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-6b, items 1.2.5 and 1.2.7
n: Level 1 has none; Level 2 lists NICU (1.2.5) and ICU (1.2.7). Remember this: Level 1 → Level 2 adds NICU, ICU and high-risk pregnancy; Level 3 adds dialysis, rehabilitation, histopathology, decontamination room and morgue autopsy. Labs climb 20 → 60 sq. m. Word root: infirmary = Latin infirmus "not strong".

q: Which checklist requires a Dialysis Clinic inside the hospital with stations of at least 6 sq. m. each?
n: Level 3 includes a dialysis clinic (6 m² per station, water treatment room min. 12 m²).

q: Which room appears in the Level 3 Emergency Room checklist but not in Levels 1 and 2?
n: Level 3 ER adds the decontamination room and the doctor-on-duty room.

q: In the Level 1 checklist, the secondary clinical laboratory work area must be at least:
The Level 1–3 checklists require at minimum how many toilets accessible to the disabled on each floor?
o: None if there is an elevator
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-6a item 2.2.5; H-6b item 2.2.5; H-6c item 2.2.5
n: At least one PWD-accessible toilet per floor.

q: What does the asterisk (*) mean beside laundry, dietary and maintenance areas in the hospital checklists?
o: May be placed in the deep zone
Not required if the service is contracted out, with a contract or MOA secured
n: Contracted-out services need no space, but the contract is a prerequisite for the license to operate.

q: In the Infirmary checklist, where must the emergency and outpatient service be located?
o: On any floor near the nurse station
On the ground floor for easy patient access
n: Infirmary ER/OPD: ground floor, with a ramp for wheelchair access.

q: In an Ambulatory Surgical Clinic doing lithotripsy, what special room is required?
o: A room with radiation hazard-protected walls that is soundproofed
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex H-1, items 1.2.1.9 and 1.2.2.1

q: In the ASC checklist, where should the scrub-up area be placed?
o: Recessed into an alcove or other open space out of the main traffic
n: Same rule for hospital, birthing home and infirmary scrub-up areas.

q: In the Acute-Chronic Psychiatric Care Facility checklist, which unit must be located near the main entrance?
n: The admission/discharge/follow-up unit is the "front door" of the facility.

q: Which facility's checklist requires a morgue with an autopsy area?
n: Levels 1–2 and infirmary list a cadaver holding room/area only.

q: A Level 2 hospital plan shows the ER on the second floor reached by an elevator. Which checklist item does it fail?
o: Dietary at least 25 m from the morgue
Separate toilets for patients and staff in OPD
ER located on the ground floor to ensure easy access for patients
n: ER must be on the ground floor with a separate entrance.
